encounters.cc: Several weeks of sharp rectal pain during bowel movements

lines: Several weeks of sharp rectal pain during bowel movements

The patient is a 26-year-old male with a history of familial hypercholesterolemia, hypertrophic obstructive cardiomyopathy, and athletic heart syndrome with AV conduction abnormalities who presents with several weeks of rectal pain.
He describes the pain as sharp and cutting, occurring specifically during bowel movements and followed by a dull ache that lingers for a few hours.
He has noticed himself holding in stool to avoid the pain, which has made him more constipated over time.
He delayed seeking care due to embarrassment but states the pain has now started to interfere with his ability to work.
